build.name: build SPIN 6.5.2 (the instrument) from the same tarball
build.cmd: cd Src && make -s 2>&1 | grep -v -i warning | grep -iE '\berror' | head -3; test -x ./spin && echo built

build.name: generate + compile the verifier for pathfinder.pml
build.cmd: cd Examples && ../Src/spin -a pathfinder.pml 2>&1 | tail -2; gcc -O2 -w -o $BODY/build/pan pan.c && echo built

runs.name: PATHOLOGY: exhaustive search finds the deadlock (invalid end state) -- the Pathfinder reset
runs.cmd: cd Examples && $BODY/build/pan 2>&1 | grep -E 'invalid end state|errors:|States|pan:' | head -8

runs.name: replay the counterexample trail (the schedule: low holds the mutex, high blocks, low cannot run)

notes: The specimen is the FAILING model, preserved failing (not repaired). SPIN is built from the same tarball as the instrument; the vault's spin-6.5.2-holzmann record is the checker. pan finds the invalid end state that models the 1997 resets.
